name: Charles Babbage
original_name: チャールズ・バべッジ
source:
The 296th Babbage Machine, a steel giant, the "King of All-Crushing Steel".
[spoiler]A giant machine made to defend the blue sky from the "known world" menaces.
The "Steam King" Charles Babbage implanted his own entire mind on its circuitry before dying.
As a human he was part of the very first expedition that led to the discover of planet Kadath along with Randolph Carter (the Grand Librarian) and Laura Nadelmann (the Expedition Princess).
He proved to be crucial for the development of advanced steam technology, the current steam civilization wouldn't have been possible without him.[/spoiler]
